name: sports-prediction-codex-plugin
description: A transparent Codex plugin for structured sports match prediction workflows, uncertainty-aware forecasts, and educational sports analytics.

interface.shortDescription: 结构化体育赛前预测报告，强调不确定性和负责任分析。
interface.longDescription: 一个 Codex 插件，用于引导 AI agent 生成透明的赛前体育分析报告，综合球队状态、伤病、赛程、场地因素、赔率市场背景、概率估计、信心等级和不确定性说明。仅用于教育和分析，不构成投注或财务建议。
defaultPrompt: Use the sports-prediction skill to analyze an upcoming match and produce a transparent prediction report.
Use the sports-prediction skill to compare team form, injuries, schedule context, odds context, uncertainty, and confidence level.
